== Title ==
<span lang="ja">潜伏</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">位置カード上にいる自分のスパイに配備する。スパイはその位置の敵側に移動する。スパイは潜伏状態となる。自分の配備フェイズにどこかの位置にいるならば、"正体を現す"ことを選択できる（このエフェクトはロストする）。このエフェクトは「意識操作」の影響を受けない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国は常にスパイ網を維持し、反乱同盟への潜入や自らの作戦行動に関する偽情報の流布を企てている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Undercover (Dark)]].

'''Lore''' — The Empire always maintains a spy network. It plots infiltration of the Rebel Alliance and the spread of false information about its own operations.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on your spy at a location card. The spy moves to the opponent's side of that location. The spy becomes undercover. During your deploy phase, if it is at a location, you may choose to reveal its identity (this Effect is lost). This Effect is not affected by Alter.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese face prints immunity to Alter. The original English printed face does not. Japanese deploys on a spy at a location card and has the spy move to the opponent's side. English says at a site and cross spy to opponent's side. Japanese uses reveal identity. English uses break cover.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-undercover-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Undercover (Dark)]].</ref>
